title: Gideon and the Kitchen
author: Ivo Nakamura
blurb: Sebastian Dravenmoor, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
